newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - M. Stanley starts Gasonics.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - M. Stanley starts Gasonics.

text.p: -- Morgan Stanley analyst Jay Deahna said he initiated coverage of semiconductor equipment maker Gasonics International Corp with a strong buy and a $23 price target.

-- Deahna said he set earnings estimates at the high end of the current Wall Street consensus. "We believe Gasonics experienced a cyclical trough in the (September 1996 quarter) and will likely experience sequential bookings, revenue and EPS growth in FY97 with margin expansion," he said.
-- For the fiscal first quarter ended in December, Deahna said he expected Gasonics to earn $0.04 per share, a penny ahead of the current analysts' earnings consensus.
-- For the fiscal year ending September 1997, he projected the company would earn $0.50 per share, which compares with the current $0.42 per share consensus.
-- For fiscal 1998, Deahna said he estimated Gasonics would hit $1.20 per share, nearly 50 percent ahead of the $0.83 per share consensus on Wall Street.

-- "We believe (the December 1996 quarter) represented an inflection point for Gasonics and consensus EPS estimates will likely rise, potentially substantially, after the company reports," Deahna said in published comments.
-- He put no timeline on his $23 price target. He said the figure was based on a price-to-earnings multiple of 17 to 18 times his calendar 1998 estimate of $1.31 per share.
